brief:
The Shehab Wire reports that Operation Al-Aqsa Flood dismantled Gaza Division forces and exposed vulnerabilities within Israel's military infrastructure. The operation, marked by what sources describe as the collapse of the "Southern Fortress," demonstrated structural weaknesses in occupation defense systems.

The reporting describes the operation as a turning point in military dynamics, with forces overwhelming established Israeli positions in Gaza's southern sector. Details on specific tactical breakthroughs and casualty figures were not elaborated in the available summary.

title: Al-Aqsa Flood operation exposed fragility of Israeli military system, Shehab reports
